definitions.gloss: food and drink; food and beverages
definitions.explanation: A collective noun for things to eat and drink. Common on signs and in formal contexts; in casual speech, {食|た}べ{物|もの}と{飲|の}み{物|もの} is more typical.

examples.japanese: {館内|かんない}への{飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}の{持|も}ち{込|こ}みは{禁止|きんし}です。
examples.english: Bringing food and drink into the hall is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}は{各自|かくじ}で{用意|ようい}してください。
examples.english: Please prepare your own food and drink.

examples.japanese: {会場|かいじょう}では{飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}の{販売|はんばい}も{行|おこな}っているので、{手|て}ぶらで{来|き}ても{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}です。
examples.english: The venue also sells food and drink, so it's fine to come empty-handed.

notes:
Composed of {飲|いん} (drink) + {食|しょく} (eat) + {物|ぶつ} (things). A formal collective noun, very common on signage, in rules, and in business writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}の{持|も}ち{込|こ}み: bringing in food and drink
- {飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}{禁止|きんし}: no food or drink
- {飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}の{販売|はんばい}: sale of food and beverages
- {飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}{以外|いがい}: items other than food and drink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食|た}べ{物|もの}と{飲|の}み{物|もの}: food and drinks — everyday phrasing
- {飲食|いんしょく}: eating and drinking — the act, not the items
- {食品|しょくひん}: food products — narrower; refers to food alone, often packaged
